title: Polynomial-time recorder layout
statement: For every finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet, the function that sends a Boolean word $z$ to the self-delimiting packing of the list of fields in its recorder layout is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
replaced: For every source machine, the function sending an encoded header to the packed self-delimiting encoding of its full recorder layout is polynomial-time computable: every field is a constant empty word or a fixed composition of header projections, and the number of fields depends only on the machine.
